title: Cashiering Guidance: Fire & Smoke Mitigation Customer Payments, Card Surcharges and Refunds
content:
Guidance for the cashiering desk on Fire & Smoke Mitigation customer payments, the surcharge on credit card payments, and refunds of a credit balance.

## The governing rule

> The job must not be closed when a customer payment is posted. Customer payments are accepted by credit card, debit card, ACH or check and posted in full to the one job they name; a credit card payment carries a surcharge of the credit card surcharge percentage of the payment amount, booked as its own line and rounded to the cent, half up. A refund is issued only while the balance due is negative, for the credit balance but never more than the customer payment it is returned from, to its original tender, within the refund processing business days; a credit balance created by insurance proceeds is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.

## Posting a payment

- A customer payment may be posted to a job in any status except closed: dispatched, authorized, cleaning, cleaning complete, invoiced or cancelled.
- Four tenders are accepted: credit card, debit card, ACH and check.
- The payment is posted in full to the one job it names. It is not split across jobs and does not reduce any other job's balance.

## The credit card surcharge

| Tender | Surcharge line |
|---|---|
| credit card | yes: the tier's credit card surcharge percentage of the payment amount, as its own charge line |
| debit card | none |
| ACH | none |
| check | none |

The surcharge is computed on the payment amount and rounded to the cent, half up. It is booked as a separate line; the payment itself is still posted in full.

Hypothetical surcharge: a credit card payment of 100.50 at a hypothetical surcharge of 3 percent gives 3.015, which rounds half up to a surcharge line of 3.02; the payment of 100.50 is posted in full.

## Refunds

A refund is issued only while the job's balance due is negative. Its amount is the credit balance, but never more than the customer payment the refund is returned from, and it goes back to that payment's original tender within the tier's refund processing business days.

| Balance due | Customer payment refunded from | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| 0.00 or above | any | none: no credit balance |
| minus 80.00 | a payment of 200.00 | 80.00, the credit balance |
| minus 80.00 | a payment of 50.00 | 50.00, capped at that payment |

(Hypothetical balances and payments.)

A credit balance created by insurance proceeds is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.

## Basis questions

On what tender does a refund go back? The original tender of the customer payment it is returned from.

Is a debit card payment surcharged? No; only credit card payments carry the surcharge.
